title: VS-16 — URL-First Business Discovery & Owner Confirmation

notes: Implements the first bounded Category Intelligence Foundation slice: URL-first public Business discovery and owner confirmation.
Ordinary HTTPS public business websites, Wolt and Bolt Food are supported through a provider-neutral Public Business Snapshot; private connectors remain excluded.

Generic public URL fetching is an SSRF boundary: HTTPS only, no URL credentials/nonstandard ports, private/local/reserved targets and redirects are rejected, connection-time public-IP validation is enforced, proxy routing is disabled, and HTML reads are bounded.
Public observations retain provider/source URL/observed timestamp/confidence/evidence class and remain non-authoritative until owner confirmation; no fabricated business facts are permitted.
Initial Business creation from discovery is account-isolated and one-time, retaining provenance and assigning the existing Generic Business Knowledge Pack.
The approved post-onboarding visual retrofit covers Today/Home, Business/Profile, Goals and Context while preserving their existing functional/API/navigation boundaries.
Implementation head c8a3fa82dda624f555f63e47c598501bad86cfc7 passed CI run 31338865481, Security baseline run 31338865479 and Product Intake run 31338865478.

CI run 31338865481 includes authentic Expo Web verification at 390×844 and 768×1024 for URL-first discovery/confirmation plus the existing VS-15 Context regression journey; evidence is retained in artifact 9045216751 (sha256:0723f15429aa017e577ceb03121f445dd8c114669ce4e7481b3d00c0d64f6ef1).
No release, deployment or production enablement is authorized.
